changes.title: Screens that use "Accounting — Page Access" changed

plain.headline: Screens that depend on “Accounting — Page Access” changed
plain.what: The app now shows or hides things based on this permission in a different set of places (before: 16, now: 15).
plain.why: A button, menu item or page may now appear or disappear for some people.
check: Log in as someone with “Accounting — Page Access”: the related buttons, menus and pages are shown and work.
Log in as someone without it: they are hidden.

workflows: Screens/code: components/ts/accounting/ledger, components/ts/accounting/purchases, components/ts/accounting/shared, components/ts/administration/EditRole.vue, components/ts/navigation/ProfileMenu.vue, components/ts/navigation/desktop (+9 more)
qa_scenarios: Screens: open the screens listed and confirm controls tied to "Accounting — Page Access" show/hide/disable correctly for a role with and without it.
Nav: top-level navigation items for the area appear only for roles holding the permission.
